description:
Opens deterministic direct, group or project chat under current permissions.
Use when: explicit hosted chat actions after reading horizon://docs/chat.
Not for: automatic sends, repeated polling, rich-text rendering or exposing moderation credentials. Use horizon_get_chat_operation to reconcile original sends, then horizon_send_chat_message only for the explicit identical replay.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken.
Side effects: One HTTP attempt. Existing live open is a no-op. A new/expired channel allocates a fresh epoch under quota/rate gates. Subscribe before first sync/send.
Returns: {channel,serverTime}
Errors: 404 hides private/missing/expired channels or source messages. 409 OPERATION_CONFLICT/OPERATION_EXPIRED or STATE_CONFLICT requires explicit original-intent reconciliation. Never replace an unknown send UUID/time/text. 429 does not schedule a retry. CHAT_MUTED/CHAT_BANNED restrict current chat access. 501 NOT_SUPPORTED means simpleServer has no chat or polling fallback. 401 means the session is missing or expired: sign in again and retry with the new accessToken. 403 for a session means the token belongs to another user: pass the userId that signed in. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

groupId.description: Required only for a channel of this current group

kind.description: Chat audience under current friend or group permissions

peerId.description: Required only for a direct channel with this other player

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken sent only as Bearer

userId.description: Active player matching the current session and project

name: horizon_open_chat_channel
